claims.title: Geometry acceptance: selector rank, physical restoration and observation uncertainty

quoted_fields.interface: The introduced ball-centered three-prop geometry has invertible nine-state height Jacobians. A single selector supplies one local tangent, with zero tangent on a truly flat land. Acceptance requires either a valid independent physical bound or observations with their complete uncertainty.
quoted_fields.failure: The illustrative transition is not the unavailable producer cam profile. Local rank is not a theorem about all dynamical restoration; thermal coefficients are not measured. P2 capture/native/artifact gaps remain unchanged.
